Script 1 · “Conscious vs subconscious”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Your goals are conscious. Your patterns aren’t.”

Body

“You can want something with your whole heart and still end up back in the same place. That’s because the goal lives in your conscious mind, and the pattern lives underneath, in beliefs you picked up long ago. Find the belief, and you can start to rewire it.”

CTA

“I’m teaching how in a free 60-minute masterclass. Tap Sign up to save your seat.”

Shot: talking to camera, white blazer, dark backdrop. On-screen text “conscious / subconscious” in gold.

Script 2 · “The vision board”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Here’s why the vision board didn’t change anything.”

Body

“A vision board works on what you want. It doesn’t touch what you believe you deserve. When those two disagree, the belief usually wins. That’s why I blend the science of how the mind learns with the spiritual side of acting from ‘it is already yours’.”

CTA

“I’ll walk you through it in my free Rewire Masterclass. Tap Sign up below.”

Shot: talking to camera, cut to a slow pan of a notebook with the 5 lessons listed.

Script 3 · “10 minutes a day”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“This is the 10-minute practice I’d start tonight.”

Body

“Not hours of journaling. Not years of digging. Ten focused minutes, every day, that teach your mind what normal feels like now. In the class I’ll show you the practice step by step, and the science of why repetition matters.”

CTA

“The Rewire Masterclass is free, replay included. Tap Sign up.”
